name: Neon Channel Product Customizer Free
author: vertim

sections.description:
Sell custom neon signs online. Neon Channel Product Customizer (NCPC) adds a live neon sign designer to your WooCommerce products. Your customers type their text, choose a font, a colour, a size and a backboard, see their sign glow in real time with its dimensions, and add it to the cart with the right price. You receive the full design with the order.

Built for neon sign shops, sign makers, print shops and makers who sell personalised LED neon signs, name signs, wedding and event signs, business logos in neon, bar and café signs.

Try it

  • Live demo of the configurator
  • Admin demo
  • Documentation

A neon sign designer your customers will enjoy

  • Realistic live preview: glowing LED neon, light on/off switch, day/night view and your own background photos (wall, shop front, bedroom…).
  • Dimensions displayed live: width and height bars on the preview, in centimetres, inches or both.
  • Multi-line text with alignment, character and line limits per size.
  • Word by word styling (optional): a different font or colour for each word.
  • Icons in the text: add your own SVG icons (hearts, stars, logos…) that customers insert next to their words.
  • Three layouts (skins): Default (side panel with tabs), Mono (one continuous page) and Zou (collapsible cards), with your own colours, font and custom CSS.
  • Mobile first: designed for phones and tablets as well as desktops.
  • Clear help: information pop-ups on each section and example images on options.
  • Every text can be edited from one place (Configurator texts), so the configurator speaks your language and your brand voice.

Simple setup for you

  • Fixed width or fixed height sizing: define your sign sizes (for example Small 50 cm, Medium 75 cm, Large 100 cm) with their character and line limits.
  • Automatic pricing: base price per line plus price per letter, with an optional number of letters included in the base price, discounts (percentage or fixed) and a minimum price.
  • Fonts: upload your TTF neon fonts or pick Google Fonts.
  • Colours: plain colours, RGB colour-changing and flowing multi-colour effects.
  • Backboards and backboard colours (acrylic board, cut to shape, cut to letter…).
  • Custom options: yes/no, drop-down, image cards, notes or included items, each with its own price (remote control, plug type, waterproofing, gift message…).
  • Design data in the cart and in the order: text, font, colour, size, options and a preview image of the sign.
  • Works with any theme, through a dedicated design page or the [ncpc-configurator productid="123"] shortcode.
  • Translation ready.

What the free version includes

  • 1 product type: LED neon signs
  • Fixed width or fixed height sizing, up to 3 sizes
  • Up to 10 fonts and 10 colours (RGB and flowing effects included)
  • Up to 2 backboards and 3 backboard colours
  • Up to 2 custom options
  • 1 pricing table

Need more? Upgrade to NCPC Pro

NCPC Pro adds:

  • Acrylic, metal and wood channel letters in 2D and 3D, with face, trim, side and back-lit colours
  • Advanced pricing (price by real sign size, square inch/centimetre, length of LED tube) and frame-fit pricing
  • Custom sizes entered by the customer
  • Unlimited sizes, fonts, colours, backboards and options
  • Materials (indoor/outdoor), jackets and mountings with visual previews
  • Request a quote form with file uploads
  • Share and save designs
  • Production files (SVG / DXF) and manufacturer emails
  • Priority support

External services

This plugin only connects to an external service when you choose a Google Font for a configuration: the font file is then loaded by the visitor’s browser from Google Fonts (fonts.gstatic.com) to display the configurator. Google receives the visitor’s IP address and the requested font file. See the Google Fonts FAQ and Google privacy policy. Fonts you upload yourself are served from your own site.
sections.installation:
Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or later
  • WooCommerce 7.4 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later

Install

  1. In your dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Neon Channel Product Customizer” and click Install Now, then Activate.
  2. Open the NCPC menu, go to Global Settings and select (or create) the page that will display the configurator.
  3. In Configurations, create a configuration (you can start with the demo data) and set up its sizes, prices, fonts and colours.
  4. Edit a WooCommerce product and, in the General tab of the product data, attach it to your NCPC configuration.
  5. Open the product page and click Customize the product.

For permalinks, the Post name structure (/%postname%/) is recommended.
sections.faq:
What kind of signs can I sell with the free version?

LED neon signs (text and icons), sold by fixed width or fixed height sizes. Channel letters (acrylic, metal, wood, 2D and 3D) are available in NCPC Pro.

How is the price calculated?

For each size you set a base price per line and a price per letter, and optionally how many letters are included in the base price. Colours, backboards and custom options can add a fixed amount or a percentage. You can also set a discount and a minimum price. The product’s regular price is added to the customisation price.

Can I use my own fonts?

Yes. Upload any TTF font (neon script fonts work great) or pick a Google Font. Up to 10 fonts in the free version.

Can customers see the size of their sign?

Yes. The preview shows the width and height of the sign in real time, in centimetres, inches or both.

Can I translate or change the texts of the configurator?

Yes. Every text of the configurator can be changed in the Configurator tab of Settings > Language and Image. Empty fields keep the English default. The admin is translation ready.

Does it work with my theme and page builder?

The configurator runs in an isolated container, so your theme styles do not break it. It works with block themes, classic themes and page builders. You can also place it anywhere with the [ncpc-configurator productid="123"] shortcode.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes, the configurator is designed for phones, tablets and desktops.

I used NCPC Pro or Starter before. What happens with my configurations?

They are kept. The free version shows them within its own limits: extra items (sizes, fonts, colours…) are not displayed and Pro-only options are hidden. Configurations that use a Pro-only model (channel letters, advanced or frame-fit pricing) are not displayed; the administrator sees a notice on the page.

Where can I get help?

Read the documentation or ask your question in the support forum of this plugin.
sections.changelog:
4.0.0

  • New configurator: realistic live neon preview with dimensions, light on/off, day/night view and background images, redesigned for mobile.
  • New: “Configurator” texts tab to edit every text of the configurator in one place (replaces the “Main” tab; existing texts are migrated).
  • New: sizes for the fixed height model, with demo data.
  • New: default text alignment, alignment options visibility, default glow state, numbered sections, colour name on hover and minimum price settings.
  • New: number of letters included in the base price of a line.
  • New: maximum width and height for colours (visibility by sign size).
  • New: font family setting for the configurator interface.
  • Configurations created with NCPC Pro or Starter keep the limits of the free version.
  • Fix: the configuration page could not be saved from Global settings.
  • Removed the leftover license code inherited from the Starter version.
  • Plugin text domain unified to neon-channel-product-customizer-free.

3.2 2025-10-14

  • Updated plugin details page

3.1 2025-08-04

  • Fixed display issue after clicking the finish button

3.0 2025-07-22

  • More colors (10)
  • More fonts (10)
  • Backboards (2) and backboard colors
  • Custom additional options (2)
  • Different fonts and colors per word in the configurator
  • Adjustment of configuration interfaces

2.0 2025-02-05

  • Update meta data structure

1.2.0 2024-09-05

  • Review of file inclusion on admin and frontend pages
  • Fixed problem after deleting size

  • Fixed add-to-cart problem

1.0 2023-12-03

  • First stable release
